rows.suggestion: Read more official player game logs
rows.why: Each log is one page read; 100 logs would give prop research a usable sample.

rows.suggestion: Licence a depth chart and snap counts
rows.why: This is the only way to answer the 2nd/3rd/4th-string question.
Without prices, no edge can ever be priced. Every strategy stays unpriced.

rows.suggestion: Redefine the product as decision support
rows.why: Publish coverage, prices-blank discipline and honest grades instead of picks.

rows.suggestion: Join historical injury reports to results
rows.why: Turns the availability tracker into a measured effect instead of a list.

rows.suggestion: Add a second official season to the model
rows.why: One season of official data cannot show stability.
rows.prerequisite: Reading the 2025 pages the same way.

rows.suggestion: Keep the leaderboard as a rejection machine
rows.why: It rejected everything, which is the correct output for public data against efficient prices. Its value is stopping a lucky backtest from shipping.
Writes each prediction to an append-only file before kickoff, which is the only way to pass G12.
The repo has 11 NFL workspaces with overlapping claims. One canonical site plus an archive index would stop contradictions like the props-blocked error.
rows.prerequisite: Owner decision; other sessions own those files.

rows.why: Four of 32 rows do not reproduce yds/att. Publish our own computed average.
A routine rebuild deletes peer navigation links from the root dashboard.

rows.suggestion: Add a per-game official score check to CI
rows.why: Weekly re-read of the finished games would catch a stale snapshot immediately.

rows.suggestion: Widen prop combos only after joint measurement
rows.why: Same-player combos are positively correlated; price them jointly or not at all.
Every break-even rate on this site assumes -110 both ways. A different price changes every number.
rows.prerequisite: Real prices would replace the assumption.

rows.suggestion: Add a stale-data banner per page
rows.why: Each page states the UTC capture time so a reader can see how old it is.

rows.suggestion: Decide whether to accept backtest-only evidence
rows.why: If the owner accepts backtests, rewards can be paid on them; this site recommends not to, because luck cannot be excluded (L4).
